title: Origin story: Anansi
description: Anansi was the spider trickster of the Akan people, who won all the world's stories from the sky god Nyame by capturing the python, the leopard, the hornets, and the fairy Mmoatia — impossible tasks completed by wit alone. Enslaved Africans carried him to the Caribbean and Americas, where he became Anancy.

title: Ability profile: Anansi
description: Ranked abilities: Trickery — rank 100/100; Storytelling — rank 99/100; Escape — rank 97/100; Persuasion — rank 95/100; Resilience — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Anansi
description: Powers: The spider's web — every scheme interconnected; Ownership of all the world's stories; Survival across continents and centuries.

title: Stamina feats: Anansi
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Completed Nyame's four impossible tasks; Survived the Middle Passage in story-form.

title: Crossover notes: Anansi
description: Anansi crosses naturally with: stories, cunning, the weak outwitting the strong.

title: Cultural impact: Anansi
description: The stories themselves are his monument; every Anansi tale is his survival.

title: Generator record: Anansi
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Anansi's database.
